name: astroway/sdk
description: Official PHP SDK for the AstroWay API — natal, synastry, transits, Vedic, Human Design, Tarot, Numerology, AI horoscopes. Type-safe, retry-aware, OpenAPI 3.1 generated.

suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Battle-tested PSR-18 HTTP client. Auto-discovered if installed.
suggest.symfony/http-client: Symfony's PSR-18 client (use Psr18Client wrapper). Auto-discovered if installed.
suggest.nyholm/psr7: Lightweight PSR-7/17 implementation. Auto-discovered for request/stream factories.
suggest.symfony/cache: PSR-16 cache adapters for filesystem/redis/memcached — use any of them via the `cache` constructor option.
suggest.monolog/monolog: PSR-3 logger — pass any Monolog instance via the `logger` constructor option for request/response/error logging.
